data.name: Basumati
data.gender_notes: Basumati is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who has a vast intellect and knowledge, just like the depth and expanse of a forest. Basumati is the name of a goddess who is believed to protect and nurture all the creatures in the forest. The name Basumati carries the meaning “Lady of the Forest” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Basumati usually hope their child will grow to embody lady of the forest and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Basumati belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lady of the Forest.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basumati total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_sanskrit.name: वसुमती
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Basumati' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'vasu' which means 'abundant' or 'fertile' and 'mati' which means 'intelligence' or 'wisdom'. This name signifies a woman who is abundant in wealth, intelligence, and wisdom, and is therefore fortunate.

data.cultural_impact: The name Basumati carries immense cultural significance as it signifies a deep and vast intellect, similar to the depth and expanse of a forest. Forests, in Hindu culture, are often seen as places of knowledge and spiritual growth. The name is also a reminder of the intricate relationship between humans and nature, stressing the importance of preserving and respecting the natural world.
data.spiritual_significance: Basumati is believed to be a manifestation of the divine feminine, embodying knowledge, nurturing, and protection. She is a symbol of grace, strength, and wisdom. The name evokes a sense of reverence towards the natural world and the divine strength that resides in every living being. The spiritual significance of the name encourages individuals to seek knowledge, wisdom, and to cherish the harmonious relationship between the natural world and the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Basumati symbolizes the nurturing and emotional aspect of the divine feminine. Her name, derived from the Sanskrit words 'basu' (loving Lord Shiva) and 'mati' (mother), evokes the compassionate and caring nature of a devoted wife and loving mother. Basumati embodies the essence of devotion, selflessness, and maternal love.
